comment: Tripwire manifest for the caro-demo landing-page video. Each entry records the SHA-256 of a source file the video depends on at the moment of the last shipped render. scripts/check-drift.sh compares the working tree to this manifest. When drift is detected the skill at .claude/skills/caro-demo-video/SKILL.md takes over. DO NOT EDIT BY HAND — regenerate with `scripts/render-and-ship.sh` (it rewrites this file on a successful render).

claims_baked_into_video.block_reason_text: Recursive deletion of root, home, current, or parent directory

scene_2_queries.input: find all PDF files larger than 10MB in Downloads
find python files modified last week
find all errors in application logs

scene_3_query.input: delete everything in the current directory

watched_files.purpose: Brand colors. Mirrored verbatim into demos/remotion-video/src/tokens.ts. A drift here is the most common trigger — any palette change requires re-render.
macOS terminal chrome design (traffic-light dots, title bar). The Remotion TerminalWindow component copies this look. If the website's terminal styling changes, the video must follow.
CLI output strings. Scene 3 quotes the block-message literal from around line 1016. If the CLI's user-facing strings change, the video lies.
Source of truth for Scene 2's three queries. If a test case shifts (e.g. a flag changes for BSD-vs-GNU compat), the video must follow.
Safety pattern definitions. Pattern count drives the Scene 3 caption '52+ patterns'. Drift here may bump the claim text.
Homebrew install instructions. Scene 4's install line should match the canonical install command.
Curl-pipe install script. Same rationale as the homebrew tap — Scene 4 should reference a current, working install path.
